write.title: Write and reopen a matrix
write.description: Write a small matrix and inspect the decoded dense rows and CSR structure. The file becomes readable after finish succeeds.

selection.title: Gather rows and map columns
selection.description: Rows [3, 0, 3] preserve order and repetition. The source → output map keeps source column 2 first and column 0 second.

loading.title: Deliver ordered batches
loading.description: Two output schemas share each requested position. Missing dimensions use the schema default; present sparse zeros stay zero.
loading.expected:
positions 0..2: panel [0.0, 8.0, NaN, 1.0, 2.0, NaN]
positions 2..4: panel [6.0, 0.0, NaN, 0.0, 8.0, NaN]
positions 4..5: panel [0.0, 0.0, NaN]
delivered: 5 positions, 10 accesses
